title: RayleaBot Plugin Development Workspace
description: Local-only list of independent plugin repositories synchronized through the normal artifact installer during development. Watcher mode uses authenticated loopback control; removing an entry does not uninstall its artifact.

x-startup-environment.RAYLEA_START_RESTART: 0 (default) reuses a healthy same-checkout development runtime with matching startup configuration and scripts; 1 gracefully stops it before starting again.
x-startup-environment.RAYLEA_DEV_ARTIFACT_ROOT: Internal Server opt-in: absolute existing build directory. Enables the local development routes defined by web-api.openapi.yaml; absent by default in production. Passed only to Server, not plugin processes.

x-web-development-status: Vite GET /__rayleabot-dev/status returns app=RayleaBot Web, backendTarget and rootDir (absolute Web project root). Startup reuse requires both backendTarget and rootDir to match. This development-only Vite middleware is not a Server management API.
